component.name: COMPASS
component.summary: A TTRPG resource manager, bringing all your books, maps, etc. in one place.

description.p: COMPASS is a desktop application that helps you organize all your Tabletop RPG resources. It provides powerful tools to catalog and manage your digital library of rulebooks, adventures, maps, and other gaming materials. Supports PDFs, images, and weblinks.

ul.li: Automatic metadata extraction from PDFs and webpages (title, author, release date)
Advanced hierarchical tagging system to replace folder chaos
Multiple collections, each with their own set of tags
Four different layouts to view your collection
Fuzzy search with advanced filtering and sorting
Share your collection with others, including metadata, tags and files
No vendor lock-in - all data saved in human-readable XML
Cross-platform support with a modern UI
